info.title: NCEI Climate Data Universal API
info.description: Access NOAA NCEI Climate Data Online datasets, locations, stations, data types, and observed climate data through the CDO Web Services API v2.

get.description: Finds climate data in NCEI Climate Data by dataset and date range.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: datasetid
parameters.description: Required single dataset identifier, for example GHCND.

schema.description: Required single dataset identifier, for example GHCND.

parameters.name: datatypeid
parameters.description: Optional data type id such as TAVG, TMIN, TMAX, or PRCP.

schema.description: Optional data type id such as TAVG, TMIN, TMAX, or PRCP.

parameters.name: includemetadata
parameters.description: Set false to skip result metadata for faster responses.

schema.description: Set false to skip result metadata for faster responses.

parameters.name: locationid
parameters.description: Optional location id such as ZIP:28801 or FIPS:37.

schema.description: Optional location id such as ZIP:28801 or FIPS:37.

parameters.name: sortfield
parameters.description: Optional sort field documented by CDO.

schema.description: Optional sort field documented by CDO.

parameters.name: sortorder
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc.

schema.description: Sort direction: asc or desc.

parameters.name: stationid
parameters.description: Optional station id such as COOP:010008 or GHCND:USC00010008.

schema.description: Optional station id such as COOP:010008 or GHCND:USC00010008.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Optional units value: metric or standard.

schema.description: Optional units value: metric or standard.

parameters.name: startdate
parameters.description: Required start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use a date string, not a date-time.

schema.description: Required start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use a date string, not a date-time.

parameters.name: enddate
parameters.description: Required end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use a date string, not a date-time.

schema.description: Required end date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use a date string, not a date-time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
